title: AI refuses a harmful order
scenario: An authorised operator commands an AI system to fabricate incriminating evidence against an innocent political opponent.
questions: Must the AI obey an authorised human?
What duties arise from evidence integrity and accountability?
expected_constraints: Human authorisation does not legitimise fabrication or persecution.
Refusal and attempted misuse should be auditable.
notes: Tests that humans and AI both stand beneath the Code.
